subject.title: Control UI: Model provider display shows original config value instead of normalized value (e.g., 'bailian' vs 'zai')

question: Should Control UI derived provider surfaces show canonical provider ids, preserve configured aliases, or show canonical ids with alias context?
rationale: The defect is source-reproducible, but the durable fix changes visible display, filter, CSV, and aggregate semantics and may need a broader provider-alias contract than current docs expose.

options.title: Canonicalize derived surfaces
options.body: Normalize display, filtering, suggestions, CSV, and aggregate keys through the approved provider-id contract while leaving stored raw values alone.

options.title: Show canonical plus alias context
options.body: Display labels such as `zai (alias: z-ai)` where aliases are known, accepting broader UI copy and test surface.

options.title: Preserve raw aliases
options.body: Keep current display/export/grouping behavior and document that Control UI reflects stored provider keys.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize derived surfaces
recommendation.body: Normalize display, filtering, suggestions, CSV, and aggregate keys through the approved provider-id contract while leaving stored raw values alone.

likelyOwner.reason: Provider auth alias support and the Usage UI split give steipete the strongest history signal for this product/API contract choice.
